info: Install-specific exceptions for migrate_diffusion_properties.php. The mapping itself lives
in the script; only data that is TRUE FOR ONE ONTOLOGY belongs here. A missing file simply
means 'no overrides' — the migration never fails because of it.
Override the path with the env var MIGRATE_DIFFUSION_OVERRIDES.
SCOPE. ddo_order_swap and code_component take two optional, OR-ed keys checked against the
NODE BEING MIGRATED: 'tld' (list of top level domains) and 'roots' (list of exact tipos).
A rule with neither key is UNSCOPED and fires on every node — the old hardcoded behaviour.
post_overrides has its own scope, checked against the ROOT THE CALLER MIGRATED: the root is
listed in 'roots', or 'roots' is empty and the entry's tipo has the same tld as the root.
That is TLD scoping, not reachability: migrating numisdata50 does rewrite numisdata1285.

ddo_order_swap.info: People name/surname order in the multi-section merge path. rsc85/rsc86 are SHARED rsc tipos referenced by portals across oh/ich/actv/nexus, so this rule is tld-scoped: without the scope it fired on any ontology reusing them, exactly like the old hardcode. The scope lists the tlds whose diffusion nodes ACTUALLY reach the component_autocomplete_hi multi-section merge branch on the seeded install (dedalo_mib): numisdata, plus tch (tch309 -> tch190, whose show.ddo_map spans two section_tipos). Scoping to numisdata alone would have silently stopped flipping tch309.

code_component.info: Fallback 'official code' component, used only when it cannot be derived from the hop's own section (component_select_lang -> get_value_code). Printed as [FALLBACK] whenever it is used, and [DERIVED] when the ontology answered instead. tld 'rsc' is the tld of the seeded install's only get_value_code diffusion node (rsc993).

post_overrides.info: authorship_roles -> simple ddo chain (portal -> autocomplete_hi -> term)
